/* GENERATED FILE. Edit the generator that writes it, never this.
 *
 * One block per MESH AND SKIN, never one per colour: a stick's colour lives on the
 * item as ColorRed/ColorGreen/ColorBlue, because ModelScript has no colour key and
 * the ColorRed lines in vanilla's model SmallGoldSheet block are read by nothing.
 * The two flare cartridges are the exception that proves it: they are NOT tinted,
 * so they are one mesh under two textures, which is what keeps a brass head brass.
 *
 * NO BLOCK NAMES A SHADER. One did, a fullbright one, and the model then did not
 * draw at all: WorldItemAtlas requires model.isReady() before it will build a
 * ground entry, and the held path produced an empty hand for the same reason.
 *
 * attachment muzzle on the flare gun is mandatory, not decoration:
 * BallisticsController.java:88-92 bails out of update() when it is absent.
 */
